description: Scalable memory architecture with hybrid topic-based working memory and optional time-based episodic recall. Keeps MEMORY.md a lean routing table, adds topic files for active projects and contact files for people, and distills OpenClaw's daily notes into them. Use when the agent needs durable, organized long-term memory that survives compaction and scales across projects, contacts, and time horizons. Run /hierarchical_agent_memory status to check the current layout. For per-channel session notes, install the companion skill agent-session-state. Upgrading from v3.1 or earlier? The agent will offer to move memory/daily/ notes to where OpenClaw reads them.
